title: Quirky Dark Malaysian Chocolate Chips Muffins
description: A tangy and crumbly Malaysian dessert featuring dark chocolate chips, perfect for a festive treat. This dairy-free friendly muffin is baked in a ramekin.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: replaced with flax eggs for vegan option

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Saute the dark chocolate chips in a pan over low heat until melted and smooth.
Whisk together the flour, coconut sugar, and baking powder in a large bowl.
Add the unsweetened coconut milk, canola oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the melted dark chocolate chips.
Divide the batter evenly among 6 ramekins.
Bake for 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let the muffins cool in the ramekins for 5 minutes before serving.
